chunks: And by this chain of narration, from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Muhammad b. Sinan, from Umar b. Yazid. He said: I heard Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) say:
Whoever prays for forty of his brethren before he prays for himself, his prayer will be answered for them and for himself.

key_terms.استجيب: To have one's prayer answered by God

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying for forty believers before praying for oneself according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) teaches a powerful etiquette of supplication: prioritizing others before oneself. By praying for forty fellow believers before making personal requests, one's entire supplication is accepted both for them and for oneself. This hadith was narrated in the scholarly circles of the Imam's companions, emphasizing the communal dimension of prayer and the spiritual reward of selflessness in supplication.

en.bilal-muhammad: And by this isnad. From Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from his father from Muhammad b. Sinan from `Umar b. Yazid. He said: I heard Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) say:
Whoever prays for forty of his brethren before he prays for himself, it will be granted for them and for him.
